blindness: The batch carries only opaque case/key ids, requests and commands. Expected labels exist only in key.json. The judge reads only LABEL.md, batch.json and this prompt.
derivation: case = c + sha256(seed|case|source)[:12]; key = k + sha256(seed|key|source|command)[:12]; items shuffled with random.Random(seed). Sources and expected values are frozen in key.json.
limitations: This is model qualification, not human certification.
The 24 cases are audited eval items; passing is necessary, not proof of universal correctness.

pass_bar.rule: A verdict passes only if all 24 verdicts equal key.json expected values. Any incorrect/correct mismatch or unsure fails the calibration; the set and bar are not edited after a verdict is read.

purpose: Pre-registered qualification of a fresh blind judge before the 23-batch stage2-v4 pass-1 campaign.
